title: Natural trees through the seasons
items: Woodland and street trees, woody shrubs and vines have rounded foliage shading and warmer backlit leaves. Sunlight passing through leaves follows the shadows. Full adds smaller, layered sprays on fine twigs within 14 metres; capable devices show fine leaf relief. Balanced and Light use smaller woodland textures; their tree meshes retain their existing detail. Switching season and detail safely rebuilds the crowns.

Folded leaves and wind-bent grass catch the light more naturally; crop leaves and wall ivy share the trees' shadowed backlighting. All four years offer spring, summer, fall and winter. Winter removes deciduous leaf sprays and their shadows. Evergreens retain their winter colour, and April withholds July flowers. The 1871 scene starts on its October day; dated jaunts keep their own dates.

The pre-fire city's remaining rounded tree crowns become branching, seasonal trees. Their recorded places, sizes and inspection cards stay the same. Winter shows bare branches, and the Trees control hides them with the other trees. Burnt trees keep their scorched state through season and detail changes.
